aftermath_root_cause.root_cause: Card.getAllPossibleAbilities iterated only the current state's spell abilities; with the split card holding LeftSplit (front half, its state after the front half is cast), the RightSplit aftermath SA was never enumerated, and the front half is correctly filtered from the graveyard, so the enumeration returned [].
aftermath_root_cause.smallest_systemic_seam: append the alternate state's spells in getAllPossibleAbilities and let the existing playability filter decide; zone legality stays in the ability's own restriction

evidence.fail_before: 3/6 tests fail with empty graveyard enumeration for the front-cast state
evidence.fix_after: 6/6 pass; enumerated ability aftermath=true spell=true zone=Graveyard
